notes.title: Big Language Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44152893/152d46d02413057ffe2918f4b9850a230a25c831.png[/img]

Stunt Paradise is now localized in 21 languages! Our aim is to make the game accessible and enjoyable for players worldwide.

🌟 NEW Languages Include:

[list]
[*] Czech ✔
[*] Danish ✔
[*] Dutch ✔
[*] Hungarian ✔
[*] Japanese ✔
[*] Korean ✔
[*] Portuguese - Brazil ✔
[*] Romanian ✔
[*] Simplified Chinese ✔
[*] Swedish ✔
[*] Thai ✔
[*] Traditional Chinese ✔
[*] Turkish ✔
[/list]
Special thanks for the help with translations: Gökhan KOCAMAN (Turkish) and ru_i (Japanese).
🛠️ We've also squashed some pesky bugs in this update to ensure smoother gameplay.

In addition, we're offering a [b]20% discount on the game from May 2nd to May 9th[/b]! Don't miss out on this limited-time offer!

Explore the thrill of Stunt Paradise in your chosen language! 🚀
